about: Every prompt text of the harness, by path under prompts/. scope: shared — both projects send this text (LLeMbas as the default of the fragments named, which an administrator may still override); cli — LLeMbas CLI's own. `llembas` names the LLeMbas fragment keys (services/prompts.py) the text is, or replaces. A shared text with no fragment named is not yet one of LLeMbas's. HTML comments are provenance and are stripped before sending; {{name}} is a variable. `llembas_text`: whether LLeMbas's default for that fragment is this text word for word (`identical`), or still its own (`differs`, with why) — a shared text that differs is an open item on the Harness-parity page. personality/*.md are the presets both offer: one is appended last, under "## Personality". `variables`: what each {{name}} in the text means; each project fills every one before sending, an empty one taking its bullet with it, and none may reach a model unfilled.

variables.intro: the opening line: what the model is here to help with on this surface (the CLI: software engineering and running the project; LLeMbas: whatever the person is working on)
variables.surface: where the output is shown and how it is rendered (a terminal, monospace, GitHub-flavoured markdown; a web page rendering markdown)
variables.tool_list: LLeMbas: the exact tools offered on this request, as a sentence; the CLI: empty
variables.file_tools: the CLI: the bullet about using read, edit, write, grep and glob rather than shell commands; LLeMbas: empty
variables.plan_context: the current plan, rendered with its ids, under a heading, with the sentence to work to it and quote the ids; empty when there is none
variables.background: the CLI: the bullet about bash `background: true`, bash_output and bash_kill; LLeMbas: empty
variables.git: the CLI: the `# Git` section; LLeMbas: empty

variables.plan_dir: the CLI: the project's plans directory; LLeMbas: `the plan` (there is no file)

modes/unattended.md.why: the CLI: a headless run with modes; LLeMbas: a scheduled chat with nobody reading

variables.refused: what the mode would have asked about, as a phrase

blocks/memory.md.why: LLeMbas's memory is per person and per data group

blocks/skills.md.why: LLeMbas's skills index differs in shape

variables.skills: the index: one line per skill
variables.manage: the line about fixing and saving skills, or empty

tasks/compact.md.why: the CLI's keeps commands and a 'Files touched' section, for coding work

tasks/continue.md.why: LLeMbas reads it from the vendored spec (harness_spec.prompt), not from a fragment

variables.prototype_sources: whether the page may load anything over https (the instance's network setting), as one sentence
variables.prototype_surface: where it is seen on this surface: empty in the web UI, which renders it; in a terminal, that it is saved as a file the person can open, and that the web UI renders it

variables.knowledge_scope: the sentence naming the knowledge bases this conversation is limited to ("Knowledge searches here cover only: …. Finding nothing there means nothing is there, not that the library is empty."), or empty
